title: SubmissionBundle
description: The to-the-buyer deliverable set, on the record (P18/C1, B77§2 D2) — v1 PlacementRun's tri-state law reimplemented at the bundle grain. The expected set derives from the CONTAINER (firm_default → the filled template; client_provided → one write-back deliverable per declared source + the rendered response), NEVER from the filesystem — so a form that was never produced appears here as status=absent instead of silently missing, which is the failure mode the P18 row exists to prevent. The file's own tri-state: no bundle file = never composed; an entry absent = expected, not yet produced; refused = a lane ran and said no, reason carried; produced = path + digest + decision-record path. The composer OVERWRITES at each compose — this is the current-state record; history lives in the run log's artifact lines. The downloads surface reads THIS, not a directory scrape.

composed_by.description: The operator whose confirmed action triggered this compose — the bundle never composes unattended.

name.description: The deliverable's basename — what the downloads listing shows under 'To the buyer'. Two entries sharing a name is a compose-time refusal (v1's sort-order collision, banned), so the name is unambiguous by construction.

path.description: Pursuit-relative path the download surface serves FROM — never re-derived by basename search.

lane.description: Which exit door owes this deliverable. Named, never sniffed from the path (v1's channel lesson).

source_file.description: Write-back lanes: the buyer's declared source file this deliverable is the filled copy OF.

sha256.description: produced: digest of the file at path, read at compose time — the bundle vouches for exact bytes, not a name.

facts_path.description: produced/refused: pursuit-relative path of this deliverable's decision record (writeback-facts / template-fill-facts) — the per-file record whose name the fNN scheme keeps collision-free (B77§2 D1).

revision_n.description: produced: the drafts revision the deliverable was built from.

status.description: produced = on disk, digested, decision record attached; absent = the container expects it and no lane has produced it yet (the RECORDED absence); refused = its lane ran and refused, reason carried. Writer-enforced (the slot_count precedent — the composer, not jsonschema conditionals, holds the per-status obligations): produced always carries sha256, plus facts_path for the lanes that keep a decision record (write-back and fill; submission_render has none — its proof is the export artifact line); refused carries reason.

reason.description: refused: the lane's refusal, verbatim — the record answers 'why is this not here?' without a log dive.

hygiene.description: produced: what the file carries at the part level (P3-15, P26b-3) — the identity stamped on it and the parts a text-and-style verifier cannot see. Counts by tag and part names only, never text. `firm_identity` says whether the workspace's firm.json was set when the file was stamped; unconfigured means a blank author, never the generator's.

revision_marks.description: tag → count over word/document.xml and every header/footer part (w:ins, w:del, w:rPrChange, w:pPrChange, w:moveFrom, w:moveTo); empty on a clean file.

generator_strings.description: core-property fields that still name a generator; empty on a hygienic output.
